description: Medusa v2.10: twenty new features. KB v2 (kb read full docs, kb diff, fuzzy GTFOBins), CISA KEV mirror + offline search_cve fallback, credential vault (PBKDF2+HMAC at-rest), target dossiers, custom detector rules + policy engine (opt-in, dispatch-enforced), provider failover chain, module SDK (init/validate), skill versioning (snapshot/diff/rollback), lab campaign runner, traffic watcher, unified timeline, workspace cleaner, notification hooks (battle-integrated), wordlist mutation + cewl harvesting, recon auto-suggest on fingerprint. 12 new CLI verbs. 620 tests green.
